result.title: Floorplan-Context-Aware Cross-Environment Human Activity Recognition from mmWave Radar Point Clouds
result.summary: Human activity recognition (HAR) models based on mmWave radar point clouds and trained in controlled open spaces often experience performance degradation when deployed in furnished rooms. We propose a Floorplan-Context-Aware (FCA) HAR enhancement method that augments the input with subject-furniture relative position information to improve cross-environment performance. Because existing mmWave point-cloud datasets lack registered floorplans, we introduce a pseudo-landmark augmentation strategy for training the FCA model. In cross-environment evaluation on the mm-ADL-Home dataset, FCA achieves 77.70% accuracy and 65.49% macro-F1, improving upon the point-cloud-only direct-transfer baseline by 10.73 and 10.05 percentage points, respectively, and exceeding the strongest evaluated adaptation baseline by 7.37 and 6.27 percentage points. At deployment, FCA requires only a one-time registration of furniture landmarks, with no target-domain activity annotations or model weight updates.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向 mmWave 雷达点云的人体活动识别，提出 Floorplan-Context-Aware 方法，把人体与家具的相对位置作为附加输入，并配合伪地标增强策略，以在缺少配准平面图的条件下提升跨房间环境的表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 把环境几何上下文显式纳入输入以抵抗场景变化、并用伪地标增强替代缺失标注，可能与 LVR 中“任务必要的空间信息是否保留在内部状态”及视觉证据筛选有概念上的类比，但模态与任务相距较远，仅供核查。
